title: Text: DET Dave Littlefield ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Paint me a picture of where Jimenez was at this time last year, in AAA
And how far he came. No quotes...I’m in DC writing a column on him
Credit to him for committing himself last off season to living in Lakeland and working to get in better shape. For working to make adjustments as a pitcher at the ML level.
Thanks. You’re a talented picture painter
